title: Research-only complete prescribed-groundwater-level candidate output carrier
purpose: Resolve LOW01-G4/G5 for research qualification without admitting bottom_mode=1 through the production solver ABI.
typed_outputs: raw legacy groundwater_level_cm retained separately as provenance
complete candidate pressure_head and water_content arrays

geometry_rule.active_nodes: count of hydraulic node centers above effective H_phreatic; may equal n in the lower half-cell
geometry_rule.snap: if z(active_nodes)-H_phreatic < 1e-4 cm, snap effective H to that node and decrement active_nodes

gates: frozen geometry classifies above-top, inside-profile NN=1/2/3/4, and below-profile cases deterministically
bottom-face branch rule uses declared geometry and never z(n+1)
materialized typed candidate groundwater_level equals requested H_phreatic exactly while raw legacy gwl remains separately observable
qbot and complete candidate hydraulic arrays are copied without numerical alteration
nonclaims: carrier does not solve Richards equations
carrier does not prove LOW01-B physics
carrier does not change production soil_water_solve_result_t
carrier does not admit bottom_mode=1 in production
activation_effect: After this carrier qualifies, LOW01-B still requires LOW01-A/A2 and the constitutive bridge before live execution can become authoritative.
